name: Witch Hunter: Book of Ascension omits ranks above MaxPlayerLevel (#13613)
contract: AscensionSpellProgressionData.h carries Bola Throw rank 7 (501342, level 60) and rank 8 (501343,
level 68, Spell.dbc BaseLevel 68), plus other post-60 ranks such as Witchblight rank 6 (681221, level
68). BuildRows in modules/mod-spellbook/src/spellbook.cpp never checked CONFIG_MAX_PLAYER_LEVEL, so on
a level-60 realm the Book of Ascension listed level-68 Bola Throw rank 8 (#13613). With MaxPlayerLevel
set to 60, a level-60 Witch Hunter holding Bola Throw rank 6 (501341) sees rank 7 (501342) as available
and can train it, while rank 8 (501343) and Witchblight rank 6 (681221) are omitted from the window and
a direct purchase request for 501343 is refused.

steps.label: Fixture: hold Bola Throw rank 6 so rank 7 is trainable
Open the Book of Ascension at MaxPlayerLevel 60
Control: Bola Throw rank 7 (level 60) is available
DISCRIMINATING: Bola Throw rank 8 (level 68) is omitted above MaxPlayerLevel 60
DISCRIMINATING: spellbook_offers_spell excludes Bola Throw rank 8
DISCRIMINATING: Witchblight rank 6 (level 68) is also omitted above MaxPlayerLevel 60
Control: train Bola Throw rank 7 at the level cap
Bola Throw rank 7 is now a known row
DISCRIMINATING: Bola Throw rank 8 stays absent after republishing
Direct purchase request for level-68 Bola Throw rank 8 is refused
